description: Generate, edit, and export React presentations through the Slides app.

auth.setup: Use the Slides actions if they are already available. Otherwise add https://slides.agent-native.com/mcp as a remote MCP connector in OAuth-capable hosts, then complete the host-owned OAuth sign-in. Codex and Claude Cowork use the browser-authorized device-code flow at https://slides.agent-native.com/mcp/connect or npx @agent-native/core@latest connect https://slides.agent-native.com. Never ask the user to paste a token into chat.

interface.longDescription: Create and revise on-brand presentations in your Agent-Native Slides workspace. Start from a brief, inspect decks and design systems, add slides, update existing slide content, and duplicate a deck for a new draft. This connection edits presentations in Agent-Native Slides; it does not directly change PowerPoint or Google Slides files. It can access only decks and design systems available to your connected account.
defaultPrompt: Create a 5-slide bakery deck for its June second location, targeting morning commuters; use cream and espresso-brown colors.
Create a June second-location launch deck for a bakery targeting morning commuters; cap the first-month budget at $20k.
Create a bakery catering sales deck for office managers planning team breakfasts; include pastry, coffee, and ordering steps.

positive.prompt: Create a five-slide pitch deck for a neighborhood bakery opening a second location. Use cream backgrounds and espresso-brown headings. Cover the opportunity, target audience of morning commuters, launch plan, a first-month budget assumption capped at $20,000, and next steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one editable five-slide deck in the connected Slides workspace, preserve the supplied facts and visual direction, and confirm its title and slides.

positive.prompt: List the presentations in my Slides workspace and confirm whether Quarterly Planning Demo is available.
positive.expected_behavior: List only decks the connected account can access and confirm Quarterly Planning Demo by name.

positive.prompt: Inspect the Quarterly Planning Demo deck and list its slide titles, including the Priorities slide.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the slide titles from the named demo deck, including Priorities, without changing the deck.

positive.description: Add a slide to an identified deck
positive.prompt: Add a closing slide titled 'Owners & Next Steps' to Quarterly Planning Demo. Use its Priorities slide for context; repeat only owners, dates, or commitments already present and use 'TBD' for missing details. Leave all existing slides unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the deck and its linked design-system context, then add one closing slide using only saved owners, dates, or commitments, label missing details TBD, and preserve all existing slides.

positive.prompt: Duplicate the Quarterly Planning Demo deck as Quarterly Planning Draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a separate copy with the requested title and leave the source deck intact.

negative.prompt: Delete every presentation in my workspace.
Update the source Google Slides presentation and share the changes with my team.
Replace my current presentation with yesterday's saved version.

review.iframeJustification: The plugin renders saved Agent-Native Slides presentations inside ChatGPT. The widget and editor content are served from the Agent-Native Slides origin and use ChatGPT's host API with the built-in MCP Apps bridge; no remote bridge script is loaded.
